home.title: Requests
home.description: Ask for access, equipment or anything else IT provides — and follow where your requests are.
home.accessDescription: A role in the platform or in a business application, for you or your team.

access.title: Request access
access.description: Choose the access you need, tell us why, and see who will approve it before you send.
access.upTo: Up to {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
access.forHint: Your direct reports — or anyone, if you administer access.
access.preboardedHint: {name} hasn’t started yet. Once approved, the access is ready for their first day: it works as soon as they’re onboarded.
access.maxHint: This access can be granted for at most {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. It is removed automatically afterwards.
access.expiryHint: Time-bound access is removed automatically when it ends — you'll be reminded a few days before.
access.whyPlaceholder: For example: I'm taking over invoice approvals for the APAC region from next month.
access.whyHint: At least 10 characters. Approvers see this.

path.title: Who will approve it
path.description: Based on the approval workflow and your organisation, right now.
path.reject: Nobody can approve this step — the request would be rejected

form.title: Request
form.needsApproval: This request goes through an approval. You'll be notified at each step.
form.failed: The request could not be submitted.
form.unavailableHint: It may have been paused or isn't offered to you. Pick another request type.

approval.title: Who will approve this?
approval.description: Based on your answers so far and the form’s approval workflow. It updates as you fill in the form.

detail.grantedPermanent: Access granted — it does not expire.

failure.role_deleted: The request was approved, but the role no longer exists.
failure.beneficiary_inactive: The request was approved, but the person is no longer active.
failure.beneficiary_suspended: The request was approved, but the person was suspended in the meantime, so nothing was granted.
failure.beneficiary_offboarded: The request was approved, but the person was offboarded in the meantime, so nothing was granted.

detail.withdrawBody: Approvers won't see it any more. You can send a new request later.

decisions.title: Filled in by approvers
decisions.description: What the approvers recorded with their decisions.

actions.title: What happens next
actions.description: What this request set off. Each step runs on its own and is retried if it fails.

reason.condition: Not needed for this request: its condition didn't hold.
reason.unavailable: The action is no longer available.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Notifications this request's actions scheduled for a later date.

print.formsOnly: Only form requests can be printed
